scope: Fix peacetime borders, hide operational subdivisions, and reduce KOR subdivision density to PRK ADM2 scale.

changes.borders: Black country/coast borders. Different controllers alone do not imply a front; the pair requires valid owners/controllers and at least one occupied side. No gold default for tile c=1.
changes.hiddenBoundaries: Both vector and exact administrative/operational/residual subdivision layers remain hidden, including country selection and detail closing. Polygon fills, hit selection and occupation fronts remain operational.

koreaScale.source: geoBoundaries KOR ADM2 2020 actual 228 features; metadata reports 229, discrepancy retained.

changes.sourceIntegrity: Strict original interior membership prevents source holes and source-free faces from acquiring inferred administrative ownership. Explicit coarse residual land preserves the fixed country envelope.
changes.prk: Original ADM2 source and country outline retained; previous inferred source-free fine faces become explicit coarse residuals. Runtime fine/coarse partition changes from 653/48 to 659/488; not a byte-identical PRK subdivision.
changes.preparation: Source lock and joined input can be selected explicitly; npm data:korea/data:world target the new versioned ADM2 recipe. Old source inputs/snapshots retained.

additionalRootSuites.notes: Attribution test updated for the new source, rerun 13/13 passed. Some suites overlap with render and independent checks.

strictGeometryRegression.notes: Includes source-hole, actual country-hole, overlap, default legacy behavior and candidate fixtures.

validation.typecheck: passed; separate tsc and production build TypeScript
validation.package: 5977 pinned artifacts, 245 other countries unchanged, KOR/PRK all polygons valid, fixed country component/hole/area/bbox preserved, adjacency complete, z0–6 no interior land omissions

build.retry: Initial sandbox EPERM creating static output directory; same build passed with workspace access.

browser.verified: Black KOR/PRK/CHN borders; no administrative lines with country detail open or closed.

preserved.note: Existing game preserved; use 3030 for new map. Old catalog session cannot migrate automatically.

limits: Actual military outcomes were not re-tested through an external AI request.
Original metadata and coarse residual coverage are explicit; this is not a certification of complete administrative coverage.
